newsitem.title: USA: FULL TEXT-Quick/Reilly comment on deal talk.
newsitem.headline: FULL TEXT-Quick/Reilly comment on deal talk.

text.p: Quick & Reilly issued a statement saying it does not comment on merger rumors or speculation as a matter of policy. The firm, reported to be considering a sale of the company, also said it sees many opportunities to grow on its own.

Mentioned in news reports as possible buyers were First Union and Barnett Banks. Both banks declined to comment. Quick & Reilly shares were indicated at 32 to 33-1/2, after closing Monday at 29-5/16. A full version of the company's press release follows.
Quick & Reilly Issues Statement Regarding Press Reports on Potential Sale
PALM BEACH, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Aug. 12, 1997--The Quick & Reilly Group, Inc. (BQR) issued the following statement in response to various press reports about a potential sale of the firm:
"As a matter of policy, we do not comment on rumors or speculation about Quick & Reilly's involvement in mergers and acquisitions.

"We feel we are strategically positioned for growth. We have the right strategy in place to continue to build upon one of the brokerage industry's most outstanding performance records. We are committed to continuing to build shareholder value, and see many opportunities to do so on our own."
